items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: No, he joined just as I left.

ctx.x: He would make all sorts of excuses for anybody with talent. But he was a hotheaded Irishman, and he
would turn around in two seconds and say, 'I'm sorry' -- which people never gave him that much credit for. He was always fighting with Frank Sinatra and ...
